acceptance_criteria: All tenant schemas with webhook_subscriptions have secret_ref and secret_key_id columns
zig build migrate applies a corrective migration to fix existing gaps
description: Migration 1134_iss0112_add_secret_ref_to_tenant_schemas.sql is recorded as applied in schema_migrations but tenant_default.webhook_subscriptions is missing secret_ref and secret_key_id columns. GBL-128 also failed to add them because it targets the public schema (webhook_subscriptions is in the tenant schema). The columns were added manually as a corrective for the WF03-GH381 test run. A permanent fix is required: create a new corrective migration that adds the missing columns to all tenant schemas where webhook_subscriptions exists without these columns, or force-re-run migration 1134.
title: Migration 1134 (ISS-0112) did not add secret_ref/secret_key_id to tenant_default.webhook_subscriptions
resolution: New corrective migration 1138_iss0635_webhook_secret_ref_corrective.sql idempotently adds secret_ref and secret_key_id to all tenant schemas where webhook_subscriptions exists without them.
